title: The Weekly
thread: Surging oil above $110 and AI tech jitters collided to rattle global markets and trigger $950 million in crypto liquidations.
summary: Global markets weathered a volatile week as Brent crude surged past $110 a barrel and AI sector jitters weighed heavily on Wall Street. Meanwhile, central banks navigated persistent inflation fears while crypto markets experienced steep liquidations.

sections.p: Brent crude climbed past $110 a barrel for the first time since May amid surging geopolitical risks and disrupted energy flows.
US 10-year Treasury yields hovered near multi-year highs as hotter producer inflation fueled ongoing Federal Reserve rate hike concerns.
US stocks tumbled sharply on Friday as renewed pressure on AI infrastructure and high energy costs weighed heavily on investor sentiment.
Anthropic secured a major chip financing deal with Blackstone offering a double-digit yield ahead of its anticipated public debut.
European equities advanced over the week led by strong gains in German and British indices despite global tech headwinds.
Bitcoin rebounded past $82,000 after a sharp dip below $80,000 triggered nearly $950 million in leveraged liquidations.
